brief.headline: Hilton Surpasses 60 Hotels in Egypt, with a Growing Pipeline Representing a Combined Owner Investment of USD $1.6 Billion
bullets: Hotels & Hospitality: Hilton's Egypt portfolio reaches 60+ hotels trading and in pipeline, backed by $1.6B in owner investment, with 47 properties under development expected to create nearly 7,000 jobs.

Insurance & Retirement: New York State Common Retirement Fund is considering raising about $4bn through a collateralised fund obligation backed by stakes in private credit funds managed by Blackstone, Blue Owl Capital and others, according to a report by Bloomberg.

Earnings & AUM: EasyJet’s annual headline pre-tax profit fell 89% to £71m as higher fuel costs and weaker demand squeezed earnings ahead of its proposed £5.7bn takeover by Apollo Global Management, according to a report by Reuters.
Fundraising: Invesco Real Estate has closed Invesco Real Estate Asia Fund V with $1.35 billion of total commitments, its largest closed-end fundraise for the region.

Private Markets: The National Basketball Association is assembling a group of private capital firms to finance arena development for its proposed European league and expects commitments to exceed €10bn, according to a report by the Financial Times.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,201.09 (down 0.5% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 26.4, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.91% (down 1 bp on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.24 pts (nearly flat). High-yield credit spreads are 3.72%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading).
